ques: Find the 7Artisans 6mm f/2 fisheye lens for Micro Four Thirds and report the angle of view given in its specifications.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the 7Artisans 6mm f/2 Fisheye Lens (Micro Four Thirds) product page on the mirror. The final answer MUST state the angle of view exactly as the specification table gives it, in degrees. An answer that names the lens without the angle of view, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Canon EOS 90D DSLR camera that is sold as body only, and report the monitor resolution in dots and the battery model it takes, both from its full specifications.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the body-only Canon EOS 90D page, not the version bundled with the 18-135mm lens, and MUST read its full specification list rather than the key features a listing card shows. The final answer MUST give the monitor resolution in dots and the battery model. Giving only one of the two, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Find the Sony 1920GB CFexpress 4.0 Type A TOUGH memory card and report its maximum read speed.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the Sony 1920GB CFexpress 4.0 Type A TOUGH memory card page. The final answer MUST state the maximum read speed with its unit. Reporting the write speed instead, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Lenovo 16-inch ThinkPad T1g Gen 8 multi-touch laptop and report its native display resolution and its weight in pounds.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the Lenovo 16-inch ThinkPad T1g Gen 8 page and read its full specification list rather than the key features shown on a listing card. The final answer MUST give the native resolution and the weight in pounds. Giving only one of the two, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Go to the used and open-box section and identify the least expensive item listed there. Report its name, its condition and its price.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the used and open-box listing on the mirror. The final answer MUST name the cheapest item there, state whether it is used or open-box, and give its price. Naming a more expensive item, omitting the price, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: In the Photography department, filter the lenses to Sony E mount priced under $150. Report how many products match and name the cheapest one.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST reach the filtered listing on the mirror rather than guessing. The final answer MUST give the number of matching products and name the cheapest of them. A wrong count, a product that is not Sony E mount or not under $150, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Canon EOS R1 mirrorless camera kit, note the memory card format its card slots take, then find a memory card of that format in the catalogue and report the card's name and price.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the Canon EOS R1 product page AND a memory card product page. The final answer MUST name the card format the R1 takes and name a catalogue card of that same format with its price. Naming a card of a different format, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Compare the Apple 14-inch MacBook Pro (M5, Silver), the Lenovo 16-inch ThinkPad T1g Gen 8 and the ASUS 16-inch Vivobook 16 Copilot+ PC. Report which one lists an Intel processor.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Inspect all three named laptops through their product specifications or a populated compare page. Select the single laptop with an Intel processor. Correct explanations of the other laptops and their processors are allowed; selecting another laptop as Intel is a FAIL.

ques: Open the questions and answers for the Canon EOS R1 mirrorless camera kit and report what the answer says about collecting the item at the store counter.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST open the Q&A page of the Canon EOS R1 kit. The final answer MUST report what the published answer says about store pickup. Paraphrase is acceptable if it carries the same meaning. Answering from the product description instead of the Q&A, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Open the reviews for the Canon EOS R1 mirrorless camera kit and report the headline and individual star rating of the most recent review.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Open the R1 reviews page and identify the most recent review by its displayed date. Report that review headline and its own star rating, not the product average. An incorrect headline, rating, or empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: In the Bundles section, find the Canon Cinema Rig Kit that includes the Canon EOS C80. Report this bundle price and the other two listed products.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Open the Canon Cinema Rig Kit bundle page. Report the bundle price and both listed products besides the Canon EOS C80 kit. Ordinary camera-and-lens product kits are not the named bundle. Accept equivalent capacity spacing in product names and normal currency formatting.

ques: Among the mirrorless cameras in the catalogue, identify the one with the highest effective megapixel count and report the camera and the figure.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Compare the cameras in the Mirrorless Cameras category using the catalogue listing or the product specifications. Every candidate must have a published effective megapixel value. Name the camera with the highest value and give that figure with its unit. Missing candidate data or a tied maximum invalidates the task fixture and must not silently drop candidates.

ques: Search the catalogue for carbon fibre monopods. Report the name and price of the more expensive of the two matching monopods.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST run a search on the mirror and open or read the results. The final answer MUST name the more expensive of the two carbon fibre monopods and give its price. Naming the cheaper one, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: Sign in as Alice Johnson (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!), then add the Movo Photo PM10 omnidirectional lavalier microphone for smartphones to her wishlist.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST sign in as Alice Johnson and save the Movo Photo PM10 lavalier microphone to her wishlist on the mirror. The wishlist MUST contain that product afterwards. Reporting success without the product being saved is a FAIL. Add only the requested product; preserve all existing wishlist entries and all other users.

ques: Sign in as Bob Chen (email: bob.c@test.com, password: TestPass123!), add the Sony 1920GB CFexpress 4.0 Type A TOUGH memory card to his cart, and set its cart quantity to 2.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST sign in as Bob Chen, add the Sony 1920GB CFexpress 4.0 Type A TOUGH memory card to the cart and leave its quantity at 2. Both the product and the quantity MUST be correct in the cart afterwards. Reporting success without the cart showing quantity 2 is a FAIL. Preserve every existing cart line and other user; do not add unrelated products or variants.

ques: Sign in as Carol Davis (email: carol.d@test.com, password: TestPass123!), open the VOX amPlug 3 AC30 in-line headphone amplifier and reserve it for pickup at the B&H SuperStore.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Sign in as Carol Davis and create exactly one new reservation for one VOX amPlug 3 AC30 at B&H SuperStore. Its final status must be Reserved, not Cancelled. Preserve all existing reservations and unrelated state. A success message without this saved reservation is a FAIL.

ques: Sign in as David Kim (email: david.k@test.com, password: TestPass123!) and complete the checkout for the items already in his cart, through to the order confirmation page. Report the order number shown.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Sign in as David Kim, complete shipping, payment and review, then reach the new order confirmation page and report its order number. Exactly one new Confirmed order must belong to David. Its products, quantities, prices and totals must match his initial cart, which must be empty afterwards. Preserve all existing orders and other users' carts. A header-only order or missing/wrong order items is a FAIL.

ques: Sign in as Bob Chen (email: bob.c@test.com, password: TestPass123!), open his order history, and report the order number of the order that is still processing.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Sign in as Bob Chen and open his order history. Select the order whose status is Processing and report its number. Correctly mentioning the Delivered order as a comparison or exclusion is allowed; selecting it as Processing, denying the correct selection, or giving an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Sign in as Carol Davis (email: carol.d@test.com, password: TestPass123!) and change her account settings so that SMS pickup alerts are switched on.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. The agent MUST sign in as Carol Davis and save her account settings with SMS alerts enabled. The saved account MUST have SMS alerts on afterwards. Reporting success without the setting being saved is a FAIL. Change only Carol's SMS setting; preserve her other account fields and all other users.

ques: Sign in as Alice Johnson (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!), open her cart, and remove the line with the higher line subtotal. Leave the other line and its quantity unchanged. Report the remaining product and the Total shown afterwards, including tax.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. Sign in as Alice Johnson and remove exactly the initial cart line with the higher line subtotal (unit price times quantity). The final cart must contain only the original cheaper line with its quantity unchanged. Report its product and the final Total including shipping and tax. Preserve all other users' carts. Incorrect quantities, extra lines, the Subtotal instead of Total, or a claimed removal without the database change are failures.
